Name: Cute Pastel Froggy Plasma TV
Author: Asterisk555
TagLine: TV that looks like a frog, compatible with wall mounted TV!
Description:
_Description:_

*   TV that looks like a frog, compatible with wall mounted TV!

*   Can replace either the Plasma TV or Tropical TV

*   If you like this check out my other mods! I also do commissions and have a [Kofi](https://ko-fi.com/asteriskart)
_Quick start [CP] mobile compatible version:_

1.  For the CP (mobile compatible) version you need version ﻿﻿1.19 of [CP](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915)﻿ or higher

2.  Extract this mod and it's required mods into your mods folder (if you are confused check out [this guide](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started)﻿)

3.  It's ready to play! Default settings mean the Plasma TV will be replaced
_Config guide_

1.  Launch and then close the game so a config.json is created inside this mod's folder (or just launch the game if you are using [GMCM](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098)﻿)

2.  You can choose for the FroggyTV to replace either the 'plasma' or 'tropical' tv

3.  If you select true for "name change" it will change the name of the TV to "Big Froggy TV"
_Compatibility_

*   Built in compatibility with [Wall Televisions](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11448) (Don't use the name change feature)

*   The name change can conflict with other mods so it's set to 'false' by default﻿

*   Mobile compatible as long as you keep the default settings, since the 1.4 release doesn't have a tropical tv
_Mods used in screenshots:_

*   [Wainscotting](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11168) by krissymarie

*   [Yet another wallpaper mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2068) by spacesheepcaptain
